features: prints every log line and leaves out lines without a level
--min keeps lines at that level or higher
--grep keeps lines whose message contains the text, ignoring case
--levels prints how many lines each level has, lowest first
exit code 1 when no line is left

broken.feature: --min keeps lines at that level or higher
broken.how: --min drops the level it names and keeps only higher ones, so --min wrn prints the ERR line alone with exit code 0; a check passes anyway if it looks only at the exit code or the higher lines (such as --levels --min wrn including "ERR 1"), or runs on a log with no line at exactly the named level
